defects_found.description: GoalPlanner emitted lowercase capability names. ABI producers must emit canonical uppercase values. Resolver must validate, not repair.
capability-catalog.json contained domain-namespaced IDs (food.search, transport.book, etc.). Replaced with universal ABI catalog.
capability-contracts.json contained domain contracts. Replaced with universal capability contracts.
Missing capability.graph.created lifecycle event. Added as first-class event between RESOLVING and RESOLVED.
No ABI-conformant certification test suite. Created tests/certification/PlatformMilestoneB/capability_resolver_certification.cjs.

tsc_additional_conditions: Remove LEGACY_CAPABILITY_ALIASES after all ABI producers emit canonical names
Replace domain capability catalogs with universal catalogs — no dual sources of truth
capability.graph.created added as first-class lifecycle event
Certification suite promoted to Platform Milestone B certification, not ordinary unit test
Enforce canonical capability identifiers through Architecture Lint once migration complete
open_risks: LEGACY_CAPABILITY_ALIASES still present — deprecated with TSC removal condition documented
Performance SLO (5ms) enforced by CI regression gate (50ms), not by tight CI budget — production telemetry required
notes: This review is a good example of the governance model working as intended: architecture unchanged, ABI stable, implementation brought into conformance through targeted fixes rather than redesign.
